aiChat.description: Connect your own AI via an OpenAI-compatible API to query, summarize, organize and even modify your collection.
aiChat.entryMeta: Built-in AI chat wired to your collection data
aiChat.queued: Queued — will send after this reply
aiChat.example1: How much did I spend this month?
aiChat.example2: Where are my Genshin goods stored?
aiChat.example3: Add a Hatsune Miku badge, 30 CNY
aiChat.example4: Which character do I own the most goods of?
aiChat.example5: How much have I made from sold goods? What's still listed?
aiChat.example6: Which items in my wishlist are the most expensive?
aiChat.example7: Which IP do I have the most goods from?
aiChat.example8: How much have I spent on game top-ups in total?
aiChat.example9: Which events have I attended? How much were the tickets?
aiChat.example10: Mark the Miku badge as sold for 35 CNY
aiChat.errorNoConfig: Fill in the base URL, model name and API key first
aiChat.apiKeyHint: The config is stored on this device only and used to call the OpenAI-compatible endpoint you provide (/chat/completions).
aiChat.searchApiKeyPlaceholder: tvly-… — leave empty to disable web search
aiChat.searchNotice: With a key, the AI can look up current info such as new anime, product releases, and market prices. The key stays on this device.
aiChat.writeNotice: The AI can add, update or trash (recoverable) items — keep an eye on its changes.
aiChat.visionNotice: Attached images are not analyzed automatically. The vision model is only called when you explicitly ask the assistant to look at a picture. It must support image input.
aiChat.attachFailed: Failed to pick image, try again
aiChat.attachNeedText: Add a short request too (e.g. describe this image)
aiChat.attachTableFailed: Failed to read table file, try again
aiChat.undoFailed: Undo failed; some data may still be changed
aiChat.undoSending: AI is still replying — try undo later
aiChat.undoDone: Changes from this turn were undone
